name: manage_reminders
description: Create, list, update, or delete reminders for the user. Use this when the user asks to set a reminder (e.g., 'remind me to check the news at 9am daily'), view their reminders, update an existing reminder, or cancel a reminder.

action.description: The action to perform: 'create' to add a reminder, 'list' to view all, 'update' to modify, or 'delete' to remove one.

time.description: Required for 'create'. ISO 8601 formatted datetime string for when the reminder triggers (e.g. 2026-04-09T09:00:00Z). Must be in the future.

message.description: The message to send the user when the reminder triggers. Not required if 'skillName' is used.

repeat.description: Optional recurrence pattern for 'create' or 'update'. Omit for one-time reminders.

reminder_id.description: Required for 'delete' and 'update'. The UUID of the reminder to modify/delete, obtained by calling 'list'.

skillName.description: Optional name of the skill to execute when the reminder triggers (e.g., 'voice', 'search_web'). Use 'noop' if only a text message should be sent.

skillArgs.description: Optional JSON object mapping arguments to pass to the skill when it triggers (e.g. {"query": "news"} for search).
